content.short: IX Swap is an AMM-powered DeFi platform for investing in and trading tokenized real-world assets (RWAs).
content.description: IX Swap enables investors to participate in and trade tokenized real-world assets (RWAs) on an AMM-powered, blockchain-based platform. By connecting tokenized assets to a global retail market, IX Swap helps emerging startups modernize crowdfunding and expands access to capital for new ventures. Investors can pursue diversified opportunities tied to traditional assets, while tokenized offerings gain exposure to a worldwide market through transparent, decentralized infrastructure.
content.meta: IX Swap enables investment and trading in tokenized RWAs on an AMM-powered platform. Discover IX Swap and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
